age.evidence: The experiments were performed on adult male Wistar rats (SPF Velaz, s.r.o., Czechia) weighing 280-300 g at the time of surgery.

sex.evidence: The experiments were performed on adult male Wistar rats

dosing.evidence: Psilocin (PSI, THC-Pharm GmbH, Germany) was dissolved in 2 ml of saline (0.9% NaCl) acidified by 10 μl of glacial acetic acid, subsequently adjusted to a volume of 5 ml with saline and administrated in a dose of 4 mg/kg subcutaneously (SC). Each rat was recorded only once with a specific treatment.

handling.evidence: The animals were housed in pairs and were regularly handled every second day.

group_housing.evidence: The animals were housed in pairs... The rats were then housed individually in cages in order to prevent damage to implanted electrodes (individually housed after surgery, i.e., during testing).

day_night_flipped.evidence: Constant housing conditions were guaranteed during the entire period: 12-h light/dark regime... The experiments were conducted during the daytime between 8:00 and 14:00.

judge_notes: Included the home-cage behavioural activity (active/inactive ratio) as the single assay (2 of 3 candidates); it is a behavioural outcome co-registered with EEG and statistically analysed. EEG power/coherence/GFC excluded as neural recordings.
B1 scored 0 (single measure); gemma's score of 1 was inconsistent with its own value '1'.
D2 scored 2: session = 10 min baseline + 90 min post-drug (>60 min); gemma's 15-60 min category was incorrect.
application_type set to s.c. (route of the psychedelic psilocin); clozapine i.p. noted in evidence.
day_night_flipped set to 'no' (modal) with medium confidence: standard 12-h light/dark with testing during daytime 08:00-14:00.
time_dependent set to n/a per rubric (single post-dose session start), though within-session epochs were analysed (captured in B2).
n_total left null: only 'at least 8 animals' per group stated.
